idea-plugin.name: Google Play Release Blocker Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the lines that make Google Play reject your release - target API below 36, Billing Library below 8, 4 KB-only native libs - and prints the date each gate closed.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Google Play Release Blocker Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 31 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/play-release-blocker-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/play-release-blocker-lint

action.text: Google Play Release Blocker Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Google Play Release Blocker Lint on the file in the editor
